# JIIT Youth Club (JYC)

JIIT Youth Club is the student-led campus ecosystem for JIIT Noida. The public JYC website is the canonical place to discover published student clubs, events, fests, projects, moments, resources and campus activity.

## Core public pages
- / — JIIT Youth Club home: clubs, events, fests and student activity discovery.
- /clubs — official published JIIT student clubs and communities.
- /events — official published JYC events, workshops, competitions and campus activities.
- /fests — official published JYC fests and flagship campus events.
- /calendar — JYC events calendar.
- /projects — student projects published through JYC.
- /gallery — official JYC moments and event/fest photo archive.
- /discover — interest-based discovery of student communities.
- /recruitment — currently published club recruitment opportunities.
- /map — JIIT campus venues connected to JYC activities.
- /resources — student guides, campus tools and open-source pathways.
- /guide — beginner guide to participating in JYC.
- /team — public JYC team information.
- /about — what JYC is and how it connects student communities.

## Canonical content rule
Only content published by JYC administrators should be treated as official. Dynamic club and event pages are canonical when they are published and publicly accessible.

JIIT Youth Club, JYC, JIIT JYC, JIIT Youth Club Noida, JIIT Noida clubs, JIIT clubs, clubs in JIIT Noida, JIIT club list, JIIT student clubs, JIIT societies, JIIT student communities, JIIT events, JIIT event calendar, JIIT campus events, JIIT fests, JIIT fest, JIIT annual fest, JIIT cultural fest, JIIT technical fest, Impressions JIIT, Converge JIIT, JIIT club recruitment, JIIT campus activities, JIIT extracurricular activities, JIIT campus life, JIIT Youth Club events.
